task.swarm_objective: Produce a comparative analysis of NVIDIA and AMD's AI-related business performance, supported by financial filings and recent earnings information.
task.agent_directive: Research AI-related capital expenditure by Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta as a demand signal for NVIDIA and AMD, with cited figures.
constraints: Cite a source for every financial figure you record.
Use the most recently reported fiscal periods.
Focus on capital expenditure and data-center spending.

tool_arguments.query: Microsoft fiscal year 2025 Q3 capital expenditure AI data center spending

events.content: Microsoft fiscal year 2025 Q3 capital expenditure AI data center spending

Alphabet’s **Q3 2025 capital expenditures were $24.0 billion**, with the vast majority directed to technical infrastructure supporting AI and cloud demand. [[1]] 

Alphabet allocated approximately **60%** of Q3 CapEx—about **$14.4 billion**—to servers, which includes AI compute infrastructure such as GPUs and Google’s TPUs. [[1]] 

Approximately **40%**—about **$9.6 billion**—went to data-center facilities and networking equipment. [[1]] 

Management said the buildout was driven by strong Cloud-customer demand and broader growth opportunities, while highlighting investments in NVIDIA GPUs and internally designed TPUs to expand AI infrastructure capacity. [[1]] 

At the time of the Q3 release on October 29, 2025, Alphabet raised its expected **full-year 2025 CapEx to $91 billion–$93 billion**, from its prior $85 billion outlook. [[1]] 

The higher infrastructure investment was already increasing earnings pressure: Q3 depreciation rose **$1.6 billion year over year to $5.6 billion**, or **41%**, and Alphabet expected depreciation growth to accelerate slightly in Q4, alongside higher data-center operating costs such as energy. [[1]] 

For context, Alphabet ultimately spent **$91.4 billion** in CapEx for full-year 2025; its later FY2026 plan called for **$175 billion–$185 billion**, illustrating the planned step-up in AI data-center investment. [[2]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Alphabet Investor Relations - 2025 Q3 Earnings Call — https://abc.xyz/investor/events/event-details/2025/2025-Q3-Earnings-Call-2025-4OI4Bac_Q9/default.aspx
[S1.2] Alphabet Investor Relations - 2025 Q4 Earnings Call — https://abc.xyz/investor/events/event-details/2026/2025-Q4-Earnings-Call-2026-Dr_C033hS6/default.aspx

events.content: Microsoft fiscal year 2025 Q3 advertising revenue

NVIDIA’s Data Center revenue was **$30.8 billion** in **Q3 fiscal 2025** (quarter ended October 27, 2024), increasing **17% quarter over quarter** and **112% year over year**. [[1]]

Related coverage:
- **Alphabet (Q2 2026, ended June 30):** Google advertising revenue was **$81.629 billion**, up **14% year over year** from $71.340 billion; it comprised **$63.271 billion** of Google Search & Other, **$11.055 billion** of YouTube ads, and **$7.303 billion** of Google Network revenue. [[1]]
- **Meta (Q2 2026, ended June 30):** advertising revenue was **$59.363 billion**, up **27% year over year** from $46.563 billion. [[2]]
- Alphabet’s quarterly advertising revenue was therefore about **$22.266 billion higher** than Meta’s, although Meta delivered the faster year-over-year growth rate. [[1, 2]]
